import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a total sales by product bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=coffee_sales, x='product', y='total', estimator=sum, ci=None, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a total sales by product bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=coffee_sales, x='product', y='total', estimator=sum, ci=None, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
